title: Map
description: Output of Phase 0.5. Enumerates the contracts/tables/types the ask touches and their readers across three layers (source-code call sites, data-layer-resident readers such as DB function/view bodies in schema-migration files if the project uses them, and independent re-derivations). Input to the Phase 1 spec's blast-radius section and the Phase 4 blast-radius lens. Light at standard tier (touched contracts plus known catalogs), deep at architectural tier. Seeded from the knowledge store's consumer catalogs (knowledge/living-context/<domain>--<contract>-consumers.json) when one exists.

issue_number.description: Null when the map is produced before the issue exists.

seeded_from_catalogs.description: knowledge/living-context/<domain>--<contract>-consumers.json files used as seeds, if any.

name.description: Symbol, table, type, queue schema, or DB function/view name.

change_shape.description: What the ask does to it (adds column, changes return shape, new value, ...).

typescript.description: Source-code call sites and importers (file:line). Rename to your language if not TypeScript; the field name is kept for schema stability.

sql_resident.description: Data-layer-resident readers: DB function/view bodies in schema-migration files that reference it; invisible to a call-site grep. Empty if the project has no such layer.

re_derivations.description: Code paths that independently recompute the same value (diverge silently while both compile).
